text:
mika: heads-up: we're cutting schema v1 responses to v2 format in the openapi server next week. Some internal partners rely on old field names (choices->outputs). We need a deprecation plan and a shim for internal customers.
dave: for internal only we can add a response-shim middleware which keeps both fields for 60 days. Keep it behind a feature flag 'shims.response_v1_compat'. Also emit deprecation headers: X-Deprecation-Notice: schema v1 retiring in 60 days.
tara: important: don't increase payload size too much. Suggest we only include deprecated alias fields when tenant header 'X-Allow-Deprecated' present or when flag enabled for specific services.
mika: telemetry: track responses_with_alias{service,endpoint}. If aliases > 0.5% of traffic after day 30, ping owner.
ops-bot: ops-bot: deploy canary of 'response-shim-compat' at 5% cluster traffic.
dave: Implementation note: keep shim as post-processor that copies fields; zero IO to DB. Add unit tests for both directions. Also add a small feature: opt-out list in Redis for services that we will remove aliases earlier.
tara: runbook: day 0 canary, day 7 expand 25%, day14 100% of shim-only. Day 30 send final migration email to services still using aliases. Day 60 flip enforcement: remove alias fields unless tenant allows via flag.
mika: owners: Dave implements shim, Tara writes the runbook + email, Ops handles toggles. Target: roll next Wed.
dave: PR soon. I'll measure added p95 payload size increase.
ops-bot: ops-bot: canary completed - no increased error rates.
mika: reminder to docs team: update openapi examples to v2 format and link the migration notes.
dave: TL;DR: response-shim middleware for 60-day aliasing, telemetry + per-service opt-in header, enforcement after 60 days. Will post PR link.
